$comment: Claude Code runtime settings for Janice. The prompt is portable/claude-code/agents/janice.md. Read agents/janice/PORTING.md before wiring it up.
$toolsComment: No Write and no Edit: Janice reports and never fixes. Bash exists to scan transcripts with a script and to re-run read-only checks (grep, git log, git status). Bash is still a write path, so the rule against mutating checks rests on the prompt; narrow Bash with permission rules where the setup allows.
$modelComment: opus, because a wrong finding from the reviewer costs the team more trust than a wrong claim from the agent being reviewed.
